description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductOptionDao interface, providing database access methods for ProductOption entities within an e-commerce application. It includes methods to list, retrieve, and save ProductOption entities with specific filtering criteria.

classes.name: ProductOptionDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for ProductOptionDao, providing data access methods for ProductOption entities.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptions available in a specific merchant store and language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOption using its unique identifier.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves ProductOptions matching a given name within a specific store and language.

methods.name: getReadOnly
methods.description: Retrieves ProductOptions marked as read-only for a specific store and language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new or updates an existing ProductOption entity.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOption by its code within a specific store.
